court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Dr Anuja Satyajit Nighute vs Dr Satyajit Shantaram Nighute
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties are medical practitioners who got married in 2019, but their marriage is on the rocks. The petitioner fears threat to her life due to criminal antecedents of her husband's parents and seeks transfer of divorce proceedings from Sangamner to Ahmedpur.

legal_principles.principle: Convenience of wife cannot be the sole criteria for transfer of proceedings to the place where wife resides.
legal_principles.held: He submits that convenience of wife always is not the criterion for deciding the transfer application.
cited_cases: Smt. Rekha wd/o. Late Avinash Raut Vs. Shivaji Bhimrao Sapate; 2011 (3) ALL MR 279
Shri Lotal Tryambak Khairnar V/s. Narayan Hari Shinde; 2011 (3) ALL MR 282

legal_principles.principle: Subsequent matrimonial proceedings are to be transferred to the Court in which first matrimonial proceedings have been instituted.
legal_principles.held: He submits that subsequent matrimonial proceedings are to be transferred to the Court in which first matrimonial proceedings have been instituted.
cited_cases: Smt. Rekha wd/o. Late Avinash Raut Vs. Shivaji Bhimrao Sapate; 2011 (3) ALL MR 279
Shri Lotal Tryambak Khairnar V/s. Narayan Hari Shinde; 2011 (3) ALL MR 282

outcome.final_order: The court allowed the application for transfer of divorce proceedings from C.J.(S.D.), Sangamner to C.J.(S.D.), Ahmedpur.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
